summary: Liberty Defense Holdings (NASDAQ: DETX) filed a 6-K attaching an October 16, 2026 press release announcing the immediate appointment of Steve Karoly to its Board of Directors, replacing outgoing CEO Bill Frain, who departs the company at the end of October. No price, stake, premium or transaction terms were disclosed; the filing is a board/leadership transition, not a deal. Karoly, EVP of K2 Security Screening and former TSA acting assistant administrator, brings federal security procurement expertise. No advisor was named. Watch for any subsequent CEO succession announcement and disclosure of Frain's separation terms.
